paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: Analysis plot of the number of tweets corresponding to the number of sentiments.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of tweets associated with different levels of sentiment regarding COVID-19 vaccines. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of labels,” displays five discrete categories ranging from 0 to 4, with the categories presented in ascending order. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of tweets,” represents the count of tweets and employs a linear scale that extends from 0 to approximately 450,000, with tick intervals of 100,000.  The tallest bar, colored orange, corresponds to the category labeled “1,” and represents a value of approximately 380,000 tweets. The bar labeled “0,” colored light orange, represents approximately 260,000 tweets, while the bar labeled “2,” colored dark green, represents approximately 130,000 tweets.  The bar labeled “3,” colored dark green, represents approximately 70,000 tweets, and the bar labeled “4,” colored light green, represents approximately 10,000 tweets. No bars are visually emphasized or sorted in a particular order.
